tokenLanguage.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

tokenLanguage.build.command.description: This is the command that build the ${tokenLanguage.tokens.json}. Ideally, this should be a watch command so the tokens are rebuilt.

tokenLanguage.tokens.json.description: The singular json file containing the token distribution. It should be an array of token objects.

tokenLanguage.tokens.srcPackage.description: This is the absolute path of the tokens package where the ${tokenLanguage.build.command} is run. Also used to exclude the tokens project from certain diagnostics.

tokenLanguage.tokens.matchers.description: Custom regex matchers to use to identify a token.

tokenLanguage.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.
